headline: Canadian dollar weakens to 69.85 US cents as interest rate gap widens
summary: The Canadian dollar declined to around 69.85 US cents as divergence between Canadian and US monetary policies widened bond yield spreads between the two nations.
why: Yield differentials between the Bank of Canada and Federal Reserve heavily influence US dollar exchange rates.

impacts.name: CAD/USD
impacts.why: A widening interest rate advantage in favor of the US dollar weighed on the Canadian dollar.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Widening interest rate differentials between US and Canadian benchmark yields pressured the Canadian currency.
